ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
ourKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
ourKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

ourKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
ourKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
ourKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
ourKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
ourKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
ourKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
enemyKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
enemyKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
enemyKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

enemyKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
enemyKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
enemyKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
enemyKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol marks and tracks a hero, Chrono Swipe dashes in to consume the Mark for a slow and a Canister, Primeval Roar gives damage reduction then fears, and Ursine Burst grabs and slams the target
enemyKits.winCondition: track a target out of position, then grab and slam them for the kill
enemyKits.passive: every second basic attack grants Canisters for attack speed and on-hit healing; at max Canisters his Tesseract Core zaps and heals
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on the hero he grabs
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

Argus dealt 74,575 hero damage, 41% of their team's, with +540 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against Boris (level 18: about 60 magical armor, 28 after penetration; took 16,715 magical damage from heroes, 50% of all hero damage they took) and Gideon (level 16: about 46 magical armor, 19 after penetration; took 20,908 magical damage from heroes, 71% of all hero damage they took) that is about 25% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.

Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Aion (Eternal): Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.

Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 3,055 healing recorded.
Toughness: +200 health; took 26,906 damage, mitigated 19,053, died 0 times.

bullets: Peekaboo! marks targets, so a Knock, Knock! hit on a marked target adds max health magic damage, refunds 35% of the mana cost and cuts the cooldown 75%.
Alternata adds 15% to Knock, Knock!, the alternate ability, and Infernum adds Kindling on damaging hits; at four stacks the target ignites for max health damage over 2s.
Surprise, Surprise! passively adds physical penetration, and takedowns reset the camouflage cooldown, so 11 kills and 5 assists kept an escape or reposition ready.
After each ability, Cross Crunch boosts the next basic attack and trims cooldowns by 1s; Augmentation also empowers that swing, limited by a short cooldown.
Tainted Blade cuts the target's healing by 45% on physical hits, then ability hits on that healing-cut target make the target take 5% more damage for 3s.
Re-Crunch heals Crunch on every third basic attack or ability hit on heroes or monsters, and Forticus shields Crunch when hit by heroes, on a cooldown.
Each ability hit adds a 2s Disintegration stack that boosts ability damage; Ether Crystal's storm ticks every 0.5s, and Entropy adds damage once per 0.2s per ability.
Caustica adds damage only against heroes above 50% health with bonus magical armor; below 40% health, Wraith Leggings adds 12% and Synaptic Obliterator beams grow with missing health.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing 45% on magic damage; Malice stacks to 15, and each of 18 kills and 10 assists granted all 15 instantly for stronger ability hits.

coachLean.headline: A zero-death mid and steady pushes after won fights beat a Wraith who farmed our duo for kills.

flags.text: Argus ran the game: 18/0/10, 74,575 hero damage, 2,406 a minute against a usual 964.
Six of 8 won fights turned into a prize within 90 seconds; they converted 0 of their 4.
The first Fangtooth came with a lost fight 1-3: Crunch fell to Boris, Legion and Mourn to Wraith.
Legion died 8 times against a norm of 5, 4 of them to Wraith, who went 11/6/5.

focus.action: Keep walking every won fight onto a tower, and take the duo off Wraith's menu: dodge Peekaboo!, hold Beguile for whoever dives Legion, and fight after Surprise, Surprise! is spent.

878b10f5-b66b-4e65-b638-f5db2aca2149: One death all game while mitigating 50,468 damage and dealing 1,376 hero damage a minute against a usual 751.
Killed Greystone 4 times; next game, follow Khaimera's Cull suppress at once with the stun-and-knockback to finish the catch.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Rotated to the duo lane twice before their mid tower fell: Narbash and Boris died on both trips, and Mini Prime followed the second.
Put 24,450 objective damage on top of the kills, second on our side behind the jungle's 40,041.
Next game, hold Dread Nova until the Cull suppress ends so the stun extends the lockdown instead of overlapping it.
804d633f-5df9-4a34-b00c-dad04e4fcb71: Eight deaths against a norm of 5, 4 of them to Wraith, and 771 hero damage a minute against a usual 874.
Dodge Peekaboo! first, since Knock, Knock! hits much harder on marked targets, and expect a follow-up after being teleported back by Back It Up!
In teamfights, fire Orbital Sanction inside the lockdown once Beguile, Cull and Dread Nova have landed.
3899699f-5e93-4f6c-a351-bbfced4b201d: Most objective damage on either team at 40,041, with 9 kills and the only 2 enemy wards our side cleared.
Next game, open picks with the Cull suppress and let Crunch follow up for the kill.
Seedlings went 0 to 3 their way; trade a far-side camp or river buff each time they start one.
a701e81f-0a2d-45de-bc69-74a4fb9cf5d2: Kept fights alive with 21,395 healing, 25,120 mitigated and 44% kill participation, but placed only 3 wards to Narbash's 6.
Wraith scored 5 of the 9 deaths; next game, place at least Narbash's 6 wards, the extras along Wraith's duo lane.
